The decisive mistake was InformationExtraction_Expert's at step 4. After the search found the JSTOR page, that agent called `extract_pdf_text` on a PDF it merely "assumed" was downloaded. No download was ever attempted, so the call failed with a missing-file error. The agents never obtained the book text, so they never read the endnote that gives the day, 4.
